reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "PushSecret v1alpha1 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.template.engineVersion`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: PushSecret v1alpha1 resources setting spec.template.engineVersion to "v1" are rejected by the API server because that enum value was removed.
consequence.remediation: Change spec.template.engineVersion to a still-allowed value before upgrading.

proposed.statement: The enum value "v1" was removed from spec.template.engineVersion in the PushSecret external-secrets.io/v1alpha1 schema, so PushSecrets using it are rejected by the API server.
